steps.what: Locate the applicable planning-computer QA procedure and reference version
Prepare the actual reference cases and check test setup against the procedure
Perform the actual planning-computer checks and calibration measurements
Transfer selected measurement fields and calculate fixed reference differences in the QA worksheet
Verify units and case mapping and interpret discrepancies against the QA procedure
Write the actual QA findings and unresolved issues in the working check record
Save the working QA check record in the same store

tasks.design: Use version filters in {DOCS} and import selected QA measurements from {OTHER}, the treatment-planning QA system, into a fixed comparison worksheet. Keep setup, actual checks, interpretation and the factual working record with the dosimetrist.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual copying of measurements could be separate from the planning system's existing test execution.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned field mapping and fixed arithmetic can populate a draft QA comparison without a model.
tasks.still_hard: A numerical difference needs physical and clinical context; a comparison does not authorize clinical use.
tasks.human_edge: The dosimetrist recognizes unsuitable tests and unresolved discrepancies.

ambition.what: No expanded calibration or clinical-release authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: versioned measurement fields can be transferred and compared deterministically; QA interpretation remains professional work.

assumptions: Boundary is the actual scheduled QA check and its working record. A system adjustment or clinical return-to-service decision is a distinct action requiring its actual operational authority, not a save.

The dosimetrist produces measurements and checks reference-case identity in s2-s3. Contract fields are test identifier, software version, case identifier, units, measured value and reference value; capture and manual rejection of unmapped fields remain counted.
Test native QA export and comparison configuration before code. Existing test runtime and existing automatic comparisons earn no new labour saving.
Same-system save1 is minimum integer representation of near-zero effort, fully retained and ungated. Shares are unmeasured episode estimates, not time-share priors.
unknowns: Current QA export format and native comparisons
research_questions: Which manually copied fields can be mapped without losing version or units?

already_counted.description: Setup, measurements, full interpretation and actual record writing remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain version mapping and test comparison fixtures.

tasks.short: Develop patient immobilization and positioning requirements

steps.what: Read the actual treatment intent, imaging references and positioning constraints
Assess patient positioning needs and practical comfort and reproducibility constraints
Consult the actual oncology team about immobilization and positioning options
Develop and capture patient-specific device and positioning requirements
Assemble selected patient, device and positioning fields in the working requirement template
Check the complete working requirements against the patient context and intended delivery
Save the working requirements in the same planning record

tasks.design: Configure the working requirement template in {OTHER}, the treatment-planning record, to reuse the dosimetrist's selected fields. The dosimetrist still assesses the patient, consults the team, develops the requirements and checks the complete draft in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Selected device and positioning details were copied into an additional working template.
tasks.enabler_now: Native template fields can reuse exact recorded selections without proposing clinical requirements.
tasks.still_hard: Comfort and reproducibility depend on the patient and intended treatment geometry.
tasks.human_edge: The dosimetrist integrates patient needs with treatment constraints.

ambition.what: No change to treatment approval or device selection rights.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: structured templates can reuse selected patient and device fields while clinical requirements remain human decisions.

assumptions: Boundary includes developing the actual requirements in a working plan. Fabrication, fitting, actual treatment-plan release and delivery are distinct subsequent actions; no clinical release is disguised as a save.

The dosimetrist reviews source context in s1 and captures patient identifier, laterality where applicable, selected device identifier, positioning description and rationale in s4. Missing fields stay manual, not inferred from images.
Test native planning templates first; existing field reuse earns zero new saving. Only repeated manual assembly is eligible.
The near-instant same-system working save has minimum share1, fully retained without author approval. Shares are unmeasured activity estimates.
research_questions: Can selected fields populate the working template without clinical interpretation?

already_counted.description: Patient context, assessment, team discussion, requirement decisions and whole-draft checks remain.

incremental.description: Maintain device-field mapping and inspect template revisions.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R90 gives gross10 less upkeep2, net8. Low: local device codes do not match template fields, leaving7 of10 assembly hours manual;3 saved less2 upkeep gives1. Patient assessment, requirements and final checking stay fully retained.

tasks.short: Teach medical dosimetry and its application

steps.what: Read and select the actual dosimetry references and permitted teaching cases
Choose learning objectives, case sequence and application exercises
Assemble selected case figures, reference links and standard lesson sections
Write explanations and exercise prompts for the selected medical dosimetry cases

loop.input: selected references, case facts and lesson outline
loop.check: dosimetrist verifies every clinical statement, calculation explanation and learning objective against sources
loop.stop: one draft and correction pass; unsupported text is removed or written manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Explanations depend on the chosen case and learner level.

steps.what: Check the complete lesson and exercises for clinical accuracy and teaching suitability
Save the checked lesson in the same document store
Teach medical dosimetry to learners and discuss their application questions

tasks.design: Use native {DOCS} sections to assemble the selected sources and cases, with a bounded loop for draft teaching prose. The dosimetrist checks the entire lesson and teaches its application in person.
tasks.previous_blocker: Lesson preparation repeated source assembly and first-draft explanations.
tasks.enabler_now: Templates and source-bound text drafting can shorten preparation without replacing teaching.
tasks.still_hard: Clinical accuracy and learner misconceptions need expert attention.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher adapts explanations and questions to what learners actually understand.

ambition.what: Prepare a case-specific practice exercise for a learner group within the same teaching remit.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: templates and source-bound draft prose can support lesson preparation while the teacher checks clinical accuracy.

assumptions: Episode includes actual first preparation and delivery, not the same preparation charged to every repeat session. Repeated teaching must reuse the existing lesson baseline.
The dosimetrist selects and captures reference locators, figure identifiers, case facts and learning objectives in s1-s2. No free cleaned clinical feed or inferred patient facts.
Use existing permitted teaching cases and native templates first. Already automated assembly earns no new saving.

No electronic publication or external material send is hidden in in-person teaching; an actual LMS release or send needs its own actual final-version authority and action. Save1 is near-zero, fully retained and ungated.
Shares are unmeasured episode estimates, independent of supplied time priors.
unknowns: Availability of suitable teaching templates and cases
research_questions: Does the checked draft reduce preparation after clinical corrections are included?

incremental.description: Maintain source mappings and review draft prompt examples.

tasks.short: Research improvements in treatment planning systems or devices

steps.what: Read relevant research and capture the actual planning-system benchmark cases and output definitions
Design the actual research comparison and choose test conditions and interpretation limits
Carry out the actual nonclinical planning-system experiments and capture results
Transfer mapped test outputs and assemble fixed comparison tables and plots
Interpret and verify the research findings and write the actual working research account
Save the working research account in the same document store

tasks.design: For a planning-system comparison, render the selected experimental outputs from {OTHER}, the nonclinical treatment-planning research environment, into fixed tables. Keep research design, actual experiments, interpretation and the working account with the dosimetrist in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Results were copied and formatted separately after experimental runs.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned output mapping can drive deterministic comparison tables and plots.
tasks.still_hard: A benchmark improvement may not generalize to clinical treatment or other equipment.
tasks.human_edge: The researcher chooses meaningful comparisons and explains what the evidence cannot establish.

ambition.what: Compare one additional candidate planning configuration against the same defined benchmark.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: mapped experimental outputs can generate repeatable comparison tables without deciding clinical suitability.

assumptions: This is the stated task's planning-system research branch, not a claim to automate new-device engineering. Boundary includes actual experiments and their working account.

The dosimetrist selects cases and captures test identifier, configuration version, metric, units and output locator in s1; experimental output production is counted in s3. Incompatible fields stay manual.
Test native research exports and table tools first. Existing calculation and experiment runtime, and already automatic tables, earn no new saving.
Actual clinical deployment, device adjustment, repository commit or external publication requires its real final authority and separate action; none is hidden in a working save.
Save1 is minimum integer near-zero time fully retained and ungated. Episode shares are unmeasured estimates; shared QA work must be deduplicated if the same experiment serves both tasks.
unknowns: Whether the actual research is system comparison or device development
research_questions: Are outputs comparable across the configurations without new manual normalization?

already_counted.description: Source mapping, experimental design, actual tests, interpretation and research-record writing remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain output mapping and benchmark rendering checks.
